snippet.title: Indie Heroes Collection 4 - Evercade Cartridge Tour
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS.
Like on second and third Indie Heroes Collections, we get games previously featured as part of the Game of the Month program during 2023, alongside cart exclusive games. This time around, this cart contains a mixture of 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit and native games.

Games on the cart:
00:00:00 - Intro
00:00:20 - Batty Zabella (GB)
00:13:18 - Block Droppin' (GBC)
00:16:32 - Block'Em Sock'Em (MD)
00:22:53 - Collie Defense (GBA)
00:26:28 - Curse of Illmore Bay (MD)
00:34:04 - Flea! 2 (NES)
00:46:32 - Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure (NES)
00:54:13 - Murtop (Native)
01:01:21 - Nyghtmare: The Ninth King (GBC)
01:09:15 - Soko Banana (NES)
01:16:16 - Starseed (GBC)

Starseed, Block Droppin' (C) Thalamus Digital Publishing Ltd. / Rocketship Park
Block'Em Sock'Em (C) John Hancock
Nyghtmare: The Ninth King (C) Elvies
Murtop (C) hiulit
Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure (C) Bitwise Reprise LLC
Collie Defense (C) Yann Vaillant / The Retro Room
Batty Zabella (C) Ice.Cold.Blood / The Retro Room
Flea! 2 (C) Lowtek Games
Soko Banana (C) Flip For Fate
Curse of Illmore Bay (C) Second Dimension
